The shark has an open toothed mouth, visible gill slits and fins, with sparse bubbles, current marks and tiny plankton-like forms nearby. Most of the middle and lower image is open pale water, with a small cluster of marine plants along the bottom edge. The treatment uses thin black contours, subtle graphite-gray accents, an off-white paper-like field and the same organic rounded frame vocabulary visible in the continuity references.
